New Bitcoin XT version 0.11B released. Great improvement again stress test and DDoS attacks

Bitcoin XT 0.11B contains the following changes and upgrades:

  • For miners, compatibility with tools like cgminer that include 64-bit incompatible JSON
  • A size limited mempool for "stress test" resistance. Use the -maxmempooltx flag to control how many transactions are allowed in the mempool at once (default is 50000 or about 25 blocks worth). When there's an overflow, a random transaction and its children will be removed to make room.
  • Now defaults to trusting the system clock, to resolve potential issues with lying peers causing clock drift.
  • Stealth mode (activated with -stealth-mode flag), to make XT appear as Core on the network. Stealth mode can be used to hide from DDoS attacks but disables some protocol upgrades and other DoS attack fixes, so should only be used if you need
  • Improvements to the IP priorities code. You can now load IP priorities from files on disk, if you find certain IP ranges using up all your
  • XT patchlevel now appears more consistently.

I still think that people attacking XT is a promising early sign that it is expected to win out in the long term.

If someone really believes a competing technology is superior, then they would invest time trying to make it better. But if someone well positioned was expecting the technology they supported to lose, they would try to maximize that short term advantage.

I think that's the most rational explanation I can quickly come up with to explain people that use blunt force to attack XT. If it's anything less rational, all I can say is that a strategy of attacking XT to convince me not to use it backfires spectacularly.
